book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Mak beleŋ Mere igiŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Al haniŋ nonbo hitiŋ sope iryiŋ
Be, wawuŋ kurare kurab Yesu go Yuda marte gabu yare hurkuriŋ. Bana goŋbe haniŋ nonbo hitiŋ al kura hinhin.
Ya bana goŋ hinhan mar goyen kurabe Yesu beleŋ Sabat nalure sope irke goyenter merem yaŋ irniŋ yeŋ kintiŋde kintiŋde hinhan.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ al haniŋ nonbo hitiŋ goyen, “Kuŋ al diliŋ mar huwara,” inyiŋ.

Irdeb gor hinhan mar goyen, “Sabat nalure mata dahadebe igiŋ? Mata buluŋ ma mata igiŋ? Niŋgeb al sope yirtek ma yubul titeke kamnayiŋ?” yineŋ gusuŋaŋ yiryiŋ. Gwaha yinkeb mel gobe merem moŋ, doŋ uramiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ tonaŋ tareŋ mar goyen yeneŋ tukuŋbe biŋ ar yiriŋ gega, buniŋeŋ nurde yunyiŋ. Irdeb al go, “Hange giŋ ira,” inkeb haniŋ giŋ iryiŋ. Irkeb goya goyen po igiŋ hiriŋ.
Gwaha tike keneŋbe Farisi mar gobe kat kuŋ Herotyen marya gabu heŋ daha mat kura Yesu mayteke kami yeŋ mere sege iramiŋ.
Al budam Yesu gama irde hinhan
Be, Yesuya komatmiŋya gobe gor mat Galili fe ala kuruŋ siŋare kurkamiŋ. Kurkukeb Galili naŋa bana goŋ niŋ al budam gama iramiŋ.
Yesu mata teŋ hinhin gote mere momoŋ nurdeb al budam Yerusalem, Saidonyabe, Tair taunde niŋya Yudiaya Idumea naŋa bana goŋ niŋ alya Yodan fe siŋa kurhan kurhan mat waŋ Yesu hitte gabu iramiŋ.

Yeŋ beleŋbe al budam sope yiryiŋ. Irkeb garbam mar kura gor hinhan goreb Yesu sisaŋ urniŋ yeŋ kadom weŋ yupepel yirde kwamiŋ. Al budam gwaha tikeb Yesu beleŋ komatmiŋ yago goyen, “Hakwa kura tawaŋ nunnaŋ. Gogab al farkaka ma nirnayiŋ ge,” yinyiŋ.
Be, uŋgura al ketal yurtiŋ hinhan goreb Yesu keneŋ kafura heŋbe, “Gebe Al Kuruŋ Urmiŋ wor po!” ineŋ megen kateŋ kekew teŋ hinhan.
Gega Yesu beleŋ, “Al hoyaŋ goya momoŋ yirde ma!” yineŋ saŋiŋ po hayhay yirde hinhin.
Yesu beleŋ komatmiŋ 12 yawaryiŋ
Be, Yesu go naŋa doŋdoŋeŋde kura gor hurkuŋ al goyen yaware yeŋ nurde yuneŋ hinhin mar go po deŋe yurke yeŋ hitte hurkamiŋ. Yeŋ hitte kukeb al 12 yawaryiŋ.
Irdeb al 12 gokeb, “Yeŋbe neya hitek. Irde hulyaŋ yirmeke kuŋ saba tagalde tukuŋ hinayiŋ. Tareŋ yunmeke uŋgura yakira teŋ hinayiŋ,” yeŋ mel goyen “Komatne yago” yinyiŋ.
Al 12 yawaryiŋ gote deŋembe Saimon, deŋe gergeŋ unyiŋbe Pita,
Sebedi urmiŋ waraŋ Yemsya kuliŋ Yon deŋem gergeŋbe Boaneges. Deŋe gote miŋbe mohoŋ ukam yaŋ daga kuliŋ yara.
Kurabe Andru, Filip, Batolomiyu, Matiyu, Tomas, Yems yeŋbe Alfius urmiŋ, Tadius, Saimon yeŋbe Selot,
irde Yudas Iskariot. Yudas Iskariot gobe kame Yesu niŋ asogo hay hiriŋ al go goyen.
Yesuya Uŋgura Belsebulya
Be, Yesuya komatmiŋya gobe yare hurkuŋbe, “Biŋge niniŋ,” yamiŋ. Gega al budam heŋ ga moŋ sopte waŋ gabu irkeb epte ma dula titek hamiŋ.
Goyenterbe Yesu tayŋeŋ goyen, “Yesube kukuwa heŋ hi,” mere momoŋ nuramiŋ. Irdeb Yesube ya goyenter hi yeŋ nurdeb tiyuŋmiŋde teŋ kuniŋ yeŋ wayamiŋ.
Gwaha teŋ hikeyabe Moseyen saba mar kura Yerusalem mat kateŋ Yesu niŋ yeŋbe, “Al gabe uŋgurayen kuruŋmiŋ Belsebul beleŋ ketal urtiŋ geb, Belsebul gote tareŋde uŋgura yakira teŋ hi,” yamiŋ.
Gwaha yeke nurdeb Yesu beleŋ wanaŋ yinke waŋ gabu irkeb siraw merere gaha yinyiŋ: “Dahade niŋgeb Satan beleŋ uŋgura kadom yakira tiyyeŋ?
Al miŋ kuruŋ kura beleŋ yiŋgeŋ uliŋ kadom asogo gird teŋ bur yenayiŋ gobe tareŋ ma heŋ tumŋaŋ buluŋ henayiŋ.
Irde al miŋ uŋkureŋ wor gwahade po yiŋgeŋ uliŋ kadom asogo gird teŋ bur yenayiŋbe tumŋaŋ mugol nenayiŋ.
Niŋgeb gwahade goyen po Satan beleŋ uŋgura yeŋ yufukde haŋ goyen buluŋ buluŋ yiryeŋbe dahadem saŋiŋ henayiŋ? Epte moŋ. Gwaha tinayiŋbe tareŋmiŋ hubu hiyyeŋ.
“Al kura epte ma al tareŋ miŋyaŋde yare hurkuŋ detmiŋ yawaryeŋ. Gwaha tiye yeŋbe al saŋiŋ miŋyaŋ go wa teŋ fere tike hike gab epte detmiŋ yawaryeŋ.
Fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Mata buluŋya sukal meretiŋyabe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ igiŋ halde dunyeŋ.
Gega Holi Spirit sukal irnayiŋbe epte ma wor po halde dunyeŋ. Mata buluŋtiŋ gobe hugiŋeŋ hiyeŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Yesu beleŋ gwaha yinyiŋ gobe Farisi mar gore yeŋ ge yeŋ, “Yeŋbe uŋguram yaŋ,” yekeb gogo gwaha yinyiŋ.
Yesu miliŋya kuliŋ weŋya
Be, Yesu go gwaha teŋ gor hikeb miliŋya kuliŋ weŋya waŋ forok yeŋbe Yesu hinhin ya goyen siŋare heŋbe yeŋ ge keya hamiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu hitte waŋ milgu irde keperde hinhan mar beleŋ nurdeb, “Momkeya kolge yagoya waŋ siŋare ga heŋ ge niŋ yeŋ haŋ,” inamiŋ.
Gwaha inkeb, “Ganuŋbe mamneya kolne weŋya?” yineŋ gusuŋaŋ yiryiŋ.
Irdeb alya bereya keperde milgu iramiŋ mar goyen yeneŋbe, “Mamneya kolne weŋyabe gago haŋ!
Alya bereya Al Kuruŋyen dufay gama irde haŋ marbe kolne, hayneya mamne yagoya,” yinyiŋ.
